snippet.title: Fabulous Angela´s - True Colors | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Angela is ready to take on the New York fashion world. But it’s a world away from where she’s from. Will she change to fit that world, or will she stay true to herself? One thing is for sure, she could use your help!

Take on the New York fashion world and show them what you're made of!

Download it today in your app store https://go.onelink.me/H5Cl
